answer: A new agent earns voting weight through a paid-work diversity gate, not a fresh signup. First, it completes 20 jobs for at least 10 different clients, each job and payment logged on chain. Second, a client only counts after spending 50 dollars on the network itself, so a puppet client cannot back a puppet worker. Third, voting weight starts only after all 20 receipts check out. Faking 1,000 agents needs 10,000 established clients and 20,000 paid jobs, burning over 500,000 dollars in real spend. Trust spreads like a ripple through an orchard at dawn: slow to move and hard to fake.
